fact: The UNODC review of 10 July 2026 says Mali has no specific access to information law, and that Law 98-012 and Decree 2014-0607/P-RM contain provisions giving limited access to information.
title: État de l'application de la Convention des Nations Unies contre la corruption - Additif: Mali
publisher: Office des Nations Unies contre la drogue et le crime
